fields.name: Grave Hound
fields.description: a corpse-pale pack hunter that follows the scent of fear and drags isolated prey underground.

fields.name: Mire Troll
fields.description: a regenerating swamp brute covered in reeds, leeches, and stolen fishing hooks.

fields.name: Cinder Drake
fields.description: a dog-sized wingless dragon that spits burning resin and nests in chimneys.

traits: Burning Resin — A natural attack may ignite dry material; a creature hit by it takes 1 additional fire damage at the start of its next turn.

fields.name: Glass Spider
fields.description: a nearly invisible ambush predator whose brittle web cuts like wire.

fields.name: Bell Wraith
fields.description: an armored ghost that becomes solid whenever a nearby bell rings.

traits: Bellbound Form — Is incorporeal while no bell can be heard nearby and becomes solid until the end of its next turn when a bell rings.

fields.name: Lantern Maw
fields.description: a floating lure of warm light attached to a huge subterranean mouth.

traits: False Beacon — +2 to Charisma actions made to lure a creature that mistakes its glow for a safe light.

fields.name: Bone Orchard
fields.description: a rooted colony of skeletal arms that grabs creatures and plants their bones.

traits: Bone Grasp — A target hit by its grasp cannot move away until it succeeds on a Strength action to escape.

fields.name: Frost Widow
fields.description: a white cavern beast that freezes moisture into decoy silhouettes.

fields.name: Ink Leviathan
fields.description: a river monster that blinds boats with black mist before striking from below.

traits: Ink Cloud — Once per scene underwater, creates a 5-meter cloud that blinds other creatures until they leave it.

fields.name: Rust Eater
fields.description: an armored insect that rapidly corrodes metal and swarms the best-equipped target.

traits: Corrosive Bite — Natural attacks against metal objects or armor deal +2 damage.

fields.name: Dream Leech
fields.description: a translucent parasite that leaves sleeping victims awake but without memories.

traits: Memory Drain — After touching a helpless creature for one minute, erases its memory of the previous hour.

fields.name: Thornback Horror
fields.description: a territorial plant-beast that launches barbed seeds into open wounds.

traits: Barbed Seeds — Can make a ranged natural attack; a damaged target suffers -1 to Speed until the barb is removed.

fields.name: Mirror Stalker
fields.description: a thin humanoid able to move only through reflections and polished surfaces.

traits: Mirror Passage — Can enter one reflection and emerge from another visible reflection within 10 meters.

fields.name: Ash Giant
fields.description: a smoldering humanoid that collapses into choking ash when wounded, then reforms.

fields.name: Moon-Eyed Basilisk
fields.description: a six-legged reptile whose gaze petrifies only creatures standing in moonlight.

traits: Moonlit Petrification — A creature meeting its gaze while standing in moonlight cannot move until the end of its next turn.

fields.name: Choir Worm
fields.description: a tunnel predator that imitates several familiar voices at once.

traits: Familiar Voices — +2 to Charisma actions made to lure or confuse someone by imitating voices it has heard.

fields.name: Oath Devourer
fields.description: a faceless fiend strengthened whenever someone nearby breaks a promise.

traits: Broken-Oath Feast — Gains +1 to all actions until the end of its next turn whenever someone nearby knowingly breaks a promise.

fields.name: Storm Roc
fields.description: a colossal bird nesting inside thunderclouds and hunting anything carrying metal.

traits: Stormborn — Takes no damage from ordinary lightning and can fly normally through strong wind.

fields.name: Cathedral Mimic
fields.description: an ancient colony-creature disguised as an abandoned place of worship.

traits: Living Structure — While motionless, mundane inspection cannot distinguish it from the building or monument it imitates.

fields.name: Time-Starved Hunter
fields.description: a flickering predator that steals seconds from its prey to move impossibly fast.

traits: Stolen Seconds — After dealing damage, may immediately move up to half its normal movement speed.

fields.name: Crown Hydra
fields.description: each severed head regrows wearing the face and memories of its killer.

traits: Many-Headed — Cannot be surprised while at least two heads remain conscious.

fields.name: Hollow Saint
fields.description: a radiant undead figure offering miraculous healing that slowly replaces the recipient's will.

traits: False Miracle — Once per scene, restores 10% of a touched creature’s maximum HP; that creature suffers -1 to Intelligence actions until it next rests.

fields.name: Abyssal Grazer
fields.description: an enormous peaceful-looking shape whose shadow aggressively consumes living creatures.

traits: Living Shadow — Its shadow can make natural attacks against a target up to 5 meters from its body.

fields.name: Red Comet Beast
fields.description: a crystalline predator that falls from the sky and multiplies when exposed to magic.

traits: Magic Fission — The first time each scene it is affected by a spell, creates a fragile copy with 1 HP in an adjacent open space.

fields.name: Ash Phoenix
fields.description: A great incandescent bird reborn from a nearby hearth, carrying memories of those who fed the flame.

fields.name: Juvenile Ogre
fields.description: A hungry young giant imitates absent adults and turns every game into real danger.

fields.name: Hungry Changeling
fields.description: A creature copies a person’s appearance but poorly understands their habits and bonds.

traits: Imperfect Mimicry — Can copy a humanoid appearance, but gains -2 to Charisma actions involving that person’s habits or relationships.

fields.name: Imp
fields.description: A small demon offers trivial bargains whose wording hides disproportionate consequences.

fields.name: Dissolving Ooze
fields.description: A slow mass digests organic matter and soft metal, leaving objects it cannot understand.

traits: Corrosive Body — Deals 2 damage per turn to ordinary organic matter or soft metal it completely covers.

fields.name: Uprooted Treant
fields.description: A plant guardian walks far from its forest because its territory’s roots were poisoned.

traits: Rooted Stance — While touching natural ground, gains +2 to Strength actions made to resist forced movement.

fields.name: Stubborn Undead
fields.description: An animated corpse continues a daily task without realizing the world has changed.

fields.name: Patrol Skeleton
fields.description: Armed bones repeat a military route and treat every breach of protocol as intrusion.

fields.name: Mutant Animal
fields.description: An ordinary beast bears an impossible adaptation caused by magical or alchemical pollution.

fields.name: Abandoned Golem
fields.description: An artificial servant follows an order made dangerous by the absence of a master able to change it.

fields.name: Imp Chicken
fields.description: A possessed fowl displays absurd aggression, supernatural leaps, and resilience far beyond its size.

fields.name: Giant Insect
fields.description: A colossal arthropod defends a nest built around a source of heat or magic.

fields.name: Animated Statue
fields.description: A sculpture leaves its plinth to correct anyone contradicting the official event it depicts.

fields.name: Voracious Slug
fields.description: A slow creature secretes a substance that dissolves walls, armor, or memories according to its diet.

traits: Corrosive Trail — Leaves a trail that deals 1 damage per turn to one material chosen by its current diet.

fields.name: Fiery Salamander
fields.description: A supernatural reptile lives in fire and unintentionally spreads flames when frightened.

fields.name: Cliff Harpy
fields.description: A winged predator imitates familiar calls to lure travelers onto dangerous ground.

traits: Familiar Voices — +2 to Charisma actions made to lure or confuse someone by imitating voices it has heard.

fields.name: Murky-Water Siren
fields.description: An aquatic creature uses song and reflections to isolate a target from the group.

traits: Luring Song — +2 to Charisma actions made to isolate a listener that can hear the creature.

fields.name: Watcher Cyclops
fields.description: A solitary giant guards a passage whose destination is forgotten but whose prohibition remains.

traits: Keen Sight — +2 to Perception actions that rely on vision at long range.

fields.name: Hungry Vampire
fields.description: An immortal predator maintains a civil facade while scarcity makes control increasingly fragile.

fields.name: Memory Parasite
fields.description: A small creature feeds on recent memories and leaves victims unable to explain their presence.

traits: Memory Drain — After touching a helpless creature for one minute, erases its memory of the previous hour.

fields.name: Repetitive Ghost
fields.description: A spirit reenacts an incomplete scene and turns violent when witnesses change its course.

traits: Haunting Loop — Repeats one scene; witnesses who deliberately interrupt it suffer -1 to Intelligence actions until the spirit is appeased.

fields.name: Unstable Chimera
fields.description: Several incompatible anatomies struggle to control one artificially created body.

traits: Composite Instinct — Its mismatched anatomy supports this additional capability: {{ traits }}

fields.name: Unleashed Elemental
fields.description: An animated natural force restores balance without understanding the lives in its path.

fields.name: Territorial Gargoyle
fields.description: A stone sentinel changes buildings nightly and treats each new position as sacred.

fields.name: Highland Griffin
fields.description: A majestic predator protects its aerie and shiny objects mistaken for eggs.

fields.name: Reclusive Gorgon
fields.description: A cursed creature petrifies from fear more than cruelty and collects statues of visitors.

traits: Petrifying Gaze — Once per scene, a visible target that meets its gaze cannot move until the end of its next turn.

fields.name: Hunted Werewolf
fields.description: A transformed person leads hunters away from loved ones before losing control.

fields.name: Guardian Mummy
fields.description: An ancient dignitary preserves a place, oath, or error that descendants would rather forget.

fields.name: Architect Minotaur
fields.description: A creature endlessly alters its labyrinth and considers every lost traveler a willing intruder.

traits: Maze Sense — Always knows the shortest traversable route back to any place it visited within the last day.

fields.name: Giant Burrowing Worm
fields.description: A subterranean predator follows vibration and heat, causing collapses and displaced ground.

fields.name: Carnivorous Plant
fields.description: A plant colony imitates scents, voices, and shapes to attract prey.

traits: Alluring Mimicry — +2 to Charisma actions made to lure prey by imitating familiar scents, sounds, or shapes.

fields.name: Ancient Dragon
fields.description: An immensely powerful creature guards a region-shaping secret more than material treasure.

fields.name: Shoal Kraken
fields.description: A sea monster blocks a trade route and builds a nest from wrecks.

fields.name: Migrating Behemoth
fields.description: A gigantic creature periodically crosses communities built on its ancient route.

fields.name: Vengeful Spirit
fields.description: An entity bound to a specific injustice strikes the culprit’s symbols rather than true heirs.

traits: Symbol-Bound — Can sense and move directly toward any visible symbol of the injustice that binds it.

fields.name: Insect Queen
fields.description: An intelligent creature coordinates a colony and negotiates as if every individual were part of its body.

traits: Hive Mind — Can perceive through any allied insect within 100 meters and cannot be flanked by creatures they detect.
